origin.description: Ricci-Schutz coefficient of a numeric vector, also called Pietra's measure.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric vector. The measures are defined for non-negative values.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If true, drop missing values first. If false, any missing value makes the result missing.

origin.details: Mean absolute deviation from the mean, divided by twice the mean.
origin.value: A single number, the Ricci-Schutz coefficient.

translation.description: Ricci-Schutz coefficient of a numeric vector, also called Pietra's measure.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric vector. The measures are defined for non-negative values. Missing values are NaN.
